summary: @servicetitan/startup preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately runs the sibling file `math_init.js` under it via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle with obfuscator.io-style transforms (mangled identifiers, string-array cipher `n7gIxM` with rotation function `WV8StW`) and is not declared in `package.json`'s `files` allowlist (which enumerates only bin/dist/eslint/jest/patches/src/tsconfig), yet ships at the tarball root. `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, nested wrapper-object indirection) around ordinary fs/https/execFileSync/zlib calls. The package's declared purpose is a Lerna/TypeScript/React scaffolding CLI, which does not require fetching an alternate language runtime or executing an obfuscated CJS bundle at install time. The combination — alternate-runtime install-time execution of an obfuscated, undeclared sibling payload — causes arbitrary code from the shipped `math_init.js` to run on every `npm install` of this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
